description:
We are a team of three passionate high school students from Mississauga, Canada, with strong interests in computer science, mathematics, physics, robotics, and space exploration.

John has experience in Python, Java, and Luau programming, along with robotics and collaborative coding projects. Zayaan brings strong knowledge of physics and analytical problem-solving, while Hieu has excellent skills in mathematics and physics, as well as broad knowledge of astronomy and space science.
